name: Validate IBAN
description: Is this an IBAN (the international bank account number on European payments)? Checks the shape and the mod-97 checksum; answers { valid, value, country } or { valid: false, reason } — a supplier's bank details, a refund, a payroll record.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const s = String(iban ?? '').replace(/\\s+/g, '').toUpperCase(); if (!/^[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$/.test(s)) return { valid: false, reason: 'Not an IBAN' }; const r = (s.slice(4) + s.slice(0, 4)).replace(/[A-Z]/g, (c) => String(c.charCodeAt(0) - 55)); let m = 0; for (const d of r) m = (m * 10 + +d) % 97; return m === 1 ? { valid: true, value: s, country: s.slice(0, 2) } : { valid: false, reason: 'Checksum failed' }; })() }}"}]
